response.overview: "Destiny sets the tempo. You make the move."  Dance is not merely movement, it is the raw, rhythmic pulse of destiny itself—an unyielding current shaping everything in its path. Parallel to this elemental force, a soul wanders through the shadowy corridors of the self, locked in a quiet struggle between resistance and acceptance. Through a tapestry of cross-cutting imagery, the film explores the human inner labyrinth: the friction of confronting one’s dark side, the weight of hidden identities, and the quiet beauty of finally yielding to the rhythm that was guiding us all along.
response.title: ArteAlter
